title: Update kith-architecture.md for I-D alignment
description:
The architecture doc references several things that are now wrong after the I-D sync changes:
- Capability URI: urn:kith:chat:1 (line 12) -> urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat
- Chat ID model: deterministic SHA256 section needs to be replaced with ULID assignment description
- Contact -> ChatContact throughout
- ChatContact.id = userId description (no separate tailscale_user_id)
- participants -> contactId for direct chats
- senderTailscaleUserId -> senderUserId in wire format docs

Depends on: KITH-f3sp, KITH-unxn, KITH-phdk, KITH-8ntb, KITH-5nj3, KITH-sv31
